attempts.summary: Configured node1 as the persistent OpenWrt gateway: trusted 192.168.10.0/24 on eth2 and guest 192.168.20.0/24 on eth3. Both networks receive DHCP, DNS, NAT, and internet access. node2 serves “infraset-trusted” at app.home.test:8080; node4 can access it, while node3 is blocked. All four nodes passed sequential restart and recovery verification.
